Returns a recoverable error when the native Mac computer-control host is unavailable or busy, preserving the worker interpreter so the host can attach without a reset. Disconnects after an action is dispatched still fail closed; actions are never replayed automatically.

Uses Core 0.16.17 with simpler model image preparation: opaque images use JPEG quality 85 and transparent images use PNG. Original downloads and screenshot coordinates are preserved. No gateway wire changes.
